The '''Kuat City Express''' was a ferry that transported passengers from the [[Kuat Passenger Port]] to [[Kuat City]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used this service when she was pursuing [[Hurlo Holowan]] as a subcontract through [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. She secured her ticket, however, by stealing it from the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Khoss of Knylenn]].
